items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: The next band I went with was Manuel Perez. They had a band named the Imperial Band.

ctx.x: Then you... When did you... What was the next band you said you went with?
The next band I went with was Manuel Perez. They had a band named the Imperial Band.
Oh, yes. Yeah. Do you remember who else was in that band with Manuel?
